We need to get the list of all airports. Then get the first and last airport codes. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But we also need to consider booking? The user wants to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234. Possibly we need to book flight? But they want to check different options. They want to compute cost. So we need to call get_flight_cost. Then maybe we need to compute total payable amount? The user says "請提供我預估的總應付金額". That likely means the cost returned by get_flight_cost. But maybe we need to add insurance? Not specified. So just provide the cost.

We need to call get_nearest_airport_by_city? No, we need list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. So first call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond with cost.

We might also need to authenticate? The tools require access_token for many calls. But list_all_airports doesn't require token. get_flight_cost also doesn't require token. So we can call those directly.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then parse the result to get first and last airport codes. Then call get_flight_cost with those codes, date 2024-10-31, class business. Then provide cost.

We need to call the function.
